summary: Updates left/right audio pan values on the audio object and marks it dirty. Left pan (this+0x194) is written from a2 only when a2 is non-negative (compared against the zero constant dbl_59E430). Right pan (this+0x198) becomes the left pan when a3 < left pan, otherwise a3. In both paths bit 0x10000 is OR'd into the flags field (this+0xEC) to signal an update.

operations.description: Guard against negative pan: only when a2 >= 0.0 (zero constant global dbl_59E430) is a2 stored as the left pan float at this+0x194.
When right pan input a3 is less than the current left pan (this+0x194), copy the left pan value into the right pan field (this+0x198) and OR bit 0x10000 into the flags field (this+0xEC).
Otherwise store a3 directly as the right pan float (this+0x198) and OR bit 0x10000 into the flags field (this+0xEC).
Return the updated flags word of this+0xEC.
